notes.title: Important update regarding the Early Access status of Pekoe.
notes.content:
🌸 Hey Tea Makers! 🌸

We’ve got an important update about Pekoe’s Early Access.
It wasn’t an easy choice, but we made this decision with the game and our team’s well-being in mind.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/90d8db7a85e890f4ae93b4eb0db7cbaf38813a04.png

We love Pekoe and want to see it thrive as much as you do. That’s why we’ve made the tough decision to extend Early Access, despite previously announcing a 1.0 launch in Q4 2024.

Why extend Early Access?
Unforeseen complications have made it clear that Pekoe isn’t ready to leave Early Access just yet. We’ve implemented some significant changes to improve the game’s feel and performance in the long run. Our goal is to ensure you have the best, most cozy tea-making experience possible.

What does this mean?
While 1.0 won’t be released this year, we’re still actively working on content and updates! This next one is a big step forward, and we’ve got even more exciting news to share soon.

When will Pekoe leave Early Access?
We don’t have a specific date yet, but we’ll continue to listen to your feedback and keep you updated as we progress.

How are we involving the community in development?

We’re so excited to keep growing Pekoe with you! Here’s how you can get involved:  

🗺️ Follow Us On Social Media
Stay up-to-date with development by checking out our Steam announcements, discussion boards, and social media (@kittencupstudio).  

💬 Join the Conversation
Hop into our community Discord to share your thoughts, feedback, and cozy tea-time vibes with your fellow Tea Makers.  

🐞 Report Bugs
Found something wonky? Use the in-game bug reporter by pressing F2 or hovering over the top-right corner of your in-game screen to send a bug report! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/e667dcb07838e3b9d73b249f9ca01a5b156084be.gif

Thank you for your patience and support. Together, we’ll make Pekoe the best it can be! 💖🍵

notes.title: Quality of Life Update 3 [Version 0.5.4] is Now Live!
notes.content:
Hey, Tea Makers,

We've got a bunch of QoL updates coming your way! Lots of small tweaks and changes have been made to make everything work a bit smoother. We've also added some polish on things like UI and optimizations for meshes.

You might be wondering about our gap in updates and that's because dundunDUUUN we got a new programmer!🎉 Our lead programmer Justin has started a new job, [strike](he works on trucks now, very cool)[/strike] and we're thrilled to welcome Ash to the team. She worked on this update and will be with us on Pekoe moving forward. She's a wonderful addition and we're so happy to have her helping us make Pekoe even better! 🐱🍵✨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/009df8809e3aef613ea32c9d916f29212f97f717.png
As a reminder, if you are experiencing a bug, you can report it in-game by either pressing the F2 key or the drop-down button in the top right corner of the screen. Our Discord also has a bug channel for more in-depth one-on-one support! In particular, if there is a bug that you’ve already reported a while back but is still happening, there is a chance that this is a bug that we’ve had difficulty reproducing. If you’re able to hop into our Discord to help us track down and squash these pesky recurring bugs, we’d love to have you!

Until next time, here are more details on what’s included in this update!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/62109c64c3f40e5cd17319053b0ac5a3b0b0f562.png

🐞Bugs
[expand type=details]
Fixed bug where presenting tea on a saucer to customers left the saucer floating mid-air{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/c2366b2c493b640353180e2e48034c7c4e9a467a.png
Drink name is properly displayed on the back of the order card
Brewing perfect chamomile tea is now possible (“perfect“ tea requirements now have acceptable margins for time and temperature)
Fixed guests sometimes floating at bed&breakfast
Fixed a few boba syrups being free
Fixed a few environment interactables in mayors office showing an [[ERROR]]  popup
Fixed environment item descriptions in teahouses being read by last-talked-to-cat, are shown as internal narration now
Fixed ingredients hovering over cup if removed via the info bubble menu while the cup is empty
Fixed item count being shown behind items in inventory
Adjusted guest respawning logic and stopped time while taking orders in the hopes of fixing the Dine & Dash bug
Fixed kettle steam being visible on the finished drink screen
Fixed bug preventing “Clear Dust“ task from being completed. The task will also complete retroactively when you load your save.
Made lighting in shops and inventory consistent with ingredient selection
Made it harder for ingredients to clip and fall out of the cup
Fixed boba syrup pumps overfilling cups
Fixed boba syrup pumps ignoring cup lid
Fixed container capacity disappearing from info-bubble after showing a text popup
Fixed resident requesting tea not being clickable after completing an order
Fixed teaset being invisible on teaware selection screen when accepting an order with a specific recipe
Fixed materials causing noise around some objects
Fixed planter animating wrong plant when clicked in Bed'n'Breakfast
Removed floating eggs (flowers) in town
Fixed water/ice dispenser breaking after clearing table and switching ingredients
Fixed Sae getting stuck while talking
[/expand]

🌻Quality of Life
[expand type=details]
UI
Clicking on tea notification above a house (in lot view) enters the building
Added an example for custom pronouns, expanded character-limits to fit most of them
Esc while in-game opens journal instead of pop-up window
3 second wait time and a second confirmation step to delete a save file
Quit and Quit to Menu replaced with Save & Quit and Save & Quit to Menu. Made quitting without saving impossible to do on accident
Kettle boiling and whistling sounds stop when presenting tea to guests

Changes
Changed behavior of info-bubble which appears above containers and ingredients on right-click (can be hidden manually, doesn’t disappear while being hovered over, remove-ingredient buttons look how intended)
Icons for tea points and beans on order cards
Lot rotation arrows (on side of screen to orbit camera around location) are now arrows
Steep time on the drink info-bubble is of a consistent length
Removed quitting to main menu from main menu
Add a  a small animation to Date & Time panel when it locks/unlocks, hide it when making tea
Unity analytics is a checkbox
Hid the sliding window at personal tea station in level 1 house so it’s not covering Mjorns face
Changed how shadows in players house look
Changed how some materials look
Container info bubble now stays up-to date while open

Improvements
Cursors change shape when hovered over cats you can talk to, ingredients, kettle heater, when carrying ingredients, presenting tea to cats, when cups/containers are too full for what you are trying to add
Right-clicking a tea container now also shows recommended brew time & steep temperature
[/expand]

🔍Under Investigation
[expand type=details]
Dine & Dash. If a customer disappears without paying or drinking their tea in your teashop. Please let us know if it happens and report the bug with F2
 Choosing your Resident Name triggers the profanity filter. The "names of popular characters" should no longer be in the blacklist!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/5242545af6fffd30117f51ce3e7e892d5fc2438c.png
[/expand]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/9115509daec1f10cc86e833d494c1560a7b8a91a.png
As a reminder, please make sure to restart Steam to receive the update. You can see your current version number on the title screen to make sure you have the most recent update!

notes.title: Version 0.5.3: Bug Fix
notes.content:
Hello Tea Makers!

We've got one more patch to round out the month of January!

This patch fixes a bug that has been lingering for a while now. Some players, usually on certain types of mac computers, have been reporting a very obstrusive black static covering the screen that has made the game unplayable. Unfortunately, because the bug only affected very specific hardware, it's taken us a while to get the equipment to fix and test it. We're so thankful to everyone who has helped us discover this bug, and we really appreciate your patience as we worked towards fixing it! And for anyone who has had to hold off until this bug was fixed, we're so excited to finally welcome you to Pekoe.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/9115509daec1f10cc86e833d494c1560a7b8a91a.png

As a reminder, if you are experiencing a bug, you can report it in-game by either pressing the F2 key or the drop-down button in the top right corner of the screen. Our Discord also has a bug channel for more in-depth one-on-one support! In particular, if there is a bug that you’ve already reported a while back but is still happening, there is a chance that this is a bug that we’ve had difficulty reproducing. If you’re able to hop into our Discord to help us track down and squash these pesky recurring bugs, we’d love to have you!

🐞Bugs

Fixed Black Static bug that made game unplayable on certain macOS machines

Please make sure to restart Steam to receive the update. You can see your current version number on the title screen to make sure you have the most recent update!

For more information about our progress, please check out our Known Bugs & Issues page and our full  Patch History.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/e70abd606651002ff64386f0e2617df3b8d77521.png

notes.title: PEKOE UPDATE: SEASONS
notes.content:
🍵Tea's the season, everyone!❄️🌱☀️🍂

December is always a great time to reflect over the past year. A lot of changes can happen in a full year, and what better way to celebrate that than by experiencing all four seasons in our cozy tea-making game? 

That's right, we've got another big update for you, this time focused on adding content and gameplay mechanics related to Seasons! Whichever season is your favourite, we've got new art, dialogue, and gameplay for you, all outlined in the full list below!

[hr][/hr]

The Roadmap!
We're thrilled to share a glimpse into what's ahead! Seasons marks the second among a series of substantial content updates leading up to v1.0. Meanwhile, expect our routine patches and bug fixes to ensure a smooth experience. Brace yourselves for some paws-itively amazing updates that'll leave you feline hyped for more!🐾

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/2a4f47bf0a9e6934f984e6c0bad1b06054565631.png

Now let's dive in!

[hr][/hr]

Version 0.5 Seasons Update - Patch Notes:
As always, let us know your thoughts on the update in the comments or in our Discord!

Remember, if you are experiencing a bug, you can report it in-game by either pressing the F2 key or the drop-down button in the top right corner of the screen. Our Discord also has a bug channel for more in-depth one-on-one support! In particular, if there is a bug that you’ve already reported a while back but is still happening, there is a chance that this is a bug that we’ve had difficulty reproducing. If you’re able to hop into our Discord to help us track down and squash these pesky recurring bugs, we’d love to have you! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/817d4256940f92221eabfc10cd5e095ccada3004.png
❄️ Seasons
Visual environment changes and effects for each season
Music and Ambient SFX for each season
New dialogue for residents and town cats for each season
Seasons affect frequency of certain customer whim orders, such as asking for hot or cold drinks
Seasonal Ingredients
Different ingredients for each will satisfy the new “Seasonal” customer whim
These ingredients will only be available in shops during those seasons{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/78102b1886f3ddd7968288e5a696b31438493d2c.gif
🎂 Birthdays
Celebrate each resident’s birthday with special birthday-only dialogue
Visual effects on each resident’s home for their birthdays
View every resident birthday in the new Calendar in your Journal Menu
🌧️ Weather
Visual effects for snow and rain
Frequency of snow and rain affected by each season
New dialogue for shopkeeprs and town cats during snow and rain{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/06f6dfa62389f335568d098fe18156dec2691868.gif
🧊 Iced Tea
Cool down hot tea with ice, or make an iced drink to satisfy a customer whim
Water Dispensers now have an ice switch, unlocked after Town Level 5
Bubble Tea Stations have special ice containers, for adding ice with scoops
New Recipes added that require ice
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/6ea91fce4720d3a4eda381e66aa0d8999f21ed41.png
1️⃣0️⃣ More Town Levels
Maximum Town Level increased to 10
Tea Point threshold for all levels adjusted
Tea forms and teaware that were previously unlocked right away are now unlocked with first few town levels, for a more balanced and gradual game progression experience, and to encourage fully exploring all the initially available tea forms
This will not affect existing save files with the tea forms already unlocked!
📃 New Tasks
New task cards have been added, unlocked with Town Levels 1-3, to help players find tutorials for and to try out newly unlocked tea forms
🖱️ Interactive Environments
All resident homes, interiors and exteriors, have new animations and descriptive pop-ups added to various objects. Click around to explore them all!
🍵 Whim Orders
New types of whim orders added
Customers can request specific tea categories (black tea, green tea, etc.) or specific tea forms (powdered, blooming, etc.)

In between, we'll be doing our regular patch and bug fixes as needed. We have some meow-gical updates planned that you won't want to miss!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/86b10ba2897e74247ea3b15feab9ea285f6051b6.png

Our Discord also has a bug channel for more in-depth one-on-one support! In particular, if there is a bug that you’ve already reported a while back but is still happening, there is a chance that this is a bug that we’ve had difficulty reproducing. If you’re able to hop into our Discord to help us track down and squash these pesky recurring bugs, we’d love to have you! 

Now let's dive in!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/bb97cba548f331a277fd2b1defecc6555a514a88.png
Update version 0.4 Tea Making Techniques & Tweaks Patch Notes:
As always, let us know your thoughts on the update in the comments or in our Discord!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/817d4256940f92221eabfc10cd5e095ccada3004.png
Equipment - Stovetops
At the player’s shop counter, players can now make tea using Equipment, various sets of stationary machines and special teaware for even more tea making methods
After reaching Town Level 3, players will unlock the first type of Equipment, Stovetops, and receive a recipe to help them get started. Click the Equipment section of the Teaware Selection menu to get started, or check out the Equipment and Stove sections of the new Help Guide for more information.
Included in the Stovetop equipment is a new type of teaware, Saucepans. These can be used only with Stovetops, and can hold a larger number of ingredients. Heat water, brew tea, and pour your concoction all from one handy piece of teaware!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/1ed737e8c635ce09a9efd25f682901da2306ff07.gif
Equipment - Bubble Tea
After reaching Town Level 4, players will unlock Bubble Tea Station equipment, and receive some ingredients to get started. Click the Equipment section of the Teaware Selection menu to get started, or check out the Equipment and Stove sections of the new Help Guide for more information.
A version of the Bubble Tea Station is also be available at Bong-Cha’s tea table once you’ve reached a high enough friendship level with them
A new form of tea, Ready-Made Tea has been added for use with Bubble Tea Stations. This tea has already been steeped and chilled and comes out of the new Tea Dispenser for you to pour directly into your bubble tea.
A new form of ingredient container, Pump Bottles has been added for use with Bubble Tea Stations. These pump bottles contain flavoured syrups for you to use to up your bubble tea making game!
Finishing bubble tea is a little different than other types of tea. With your new Cup Machine, place a bubble tea cup inside, select a cute lid, and shake and seal your cup with a press of a button.
Once the cup is sealed, you can grab a Straw to get your cup ready to drink!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/2175f1afa4589eb54c38225fd94a06c17523c4a6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/2bdda461bbbff6ec7299d61875fd3693a21c01f8.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/6ea91fce4720d3a4eda381e66aa0d8999f21ed41.png
Help Guide
For new players and experienced tea makers alike, we’ve added a Help Guide that can be accessed by clicking the Question Mark button in the top right corner.
Some sections of the Help Guide will be displayed automatically as you progress through the game intro or unlock new features, but we encourage anyone who wants to learn more about game mechanics to explore all the different sections available!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/e9d362cad52121feb92c9ac553d11d052d04f896.png
New Recipes
More recipes have been added that can be unlocked by trying out new combinations of ingredients and flavours!
With all of these new recipes, the recipe system has been adjusted to allow for more general ingredient requirements. For example, instead of requiring “Lemon Slices” specifically, recipes may call for “Any Lemon”, which means that requirement can be met with Lemon Slices, Dried Lemon, or even Lemon Jelly
The Recipes section of the Journal Menu and the Ingredient Selection Menu now show blank buttons to indicate recipes that have yet to be unlocked! Can you discover them all?
New Dialogue
New tea making dialogue has been added for Resident Tea Requests at your window
New dialogue has been added for customers ordering tea at your shop!
New conversations have been added for Pambeh, Bug and Skipper
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/c2a0599fc0ea2fd20f5146a2dfdec55a72165623.png
More Friendship Opportunities and Rewards
Pambeh, Bug and Skipper now have friendship points and levels so you can raise your friendship with them!
Pambeh can now have regular conversations at his desk in the Town Hall. Players can select dialogue options to either proceed to his informational dialogue, or have a conversation that may include opportunities for getting friendship points.
Pambeh, Bug and Skipper can now come to your window with tea requests, for more opportunties to get friendship points
Pambeh now has three Friendship Cutscenes
Bug and Skipper now have one Friendship Cutscene each.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/b16d7e2927c27d619a3c54e9a5f8478aac2112c1.png
Visual and Audio Effects
New particle effects play when adding ingredients and stirring tea. These particle effects are color-coded to help keep track of what flavors are being added to your cup, and the primary flavor of your stirred drink.
Kettles now have additional animations playing, getting more intense as the water heats, to help you keep track of how hot the water is getting
Menus have new sound effects for selecting items and categories
New Teaware
Strawberry Teaset has been completed with a Saucer, Spoon, Heater, Kettle, Creamer, and Sugar Bowl
New mug designs have been added and are available for purchase in Resident Shops
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/391713913055b7e13267f4896ae7d88079a92c91.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/5f4f51327a4c0247b7d2554d1f3762908bb5b69e.png
Loose Leaf Tea
Ingredient Scoops have been simplified. Instead of using a scoop, then clicking a container to refill it, scoops will automatically disappear and return to their containers after being used. No more need to worry about dropping an empty scoop!
Infuser balls have been updated to remain open while not inside of a cup. This may help to keep track of which infuser balls already have tea in them.
Loose Leaf can now be added directly to a cup or saucepan without an infuser! Just remember that without an infuser, you can’t take the leaves out afterwards. Don’t forget to keep an eye on that steep time!
Ingredient Size and Container Capacity Mechanics
Ingredients now have distinct sizes, to allow for more variety. Skilled tea makers will want to keep a close eye on what ingredients they’re selecting for their tea! For more information about an ingredient’s size, check out their details in the Ingredient Selection Menu, or right click an ingredient container.
Teaware, specifically cups and teapots, now also have different sizes, with different capacities for ingredients.
To help keep track of your ingredients in this new system, we’ve updated the Fill Bar UI. There are now two bars, one that shows the amount of liquid in your cup, and one that shows the number of ingredients. Each bar may be partially greyed out to indicate space being taken up by other parts of your drink. If you have a cup filled with large tea bags, there won’t be quite as much room for liquid, and vice versa!
The Container Info UI that appears when right clicking a cup has also been updated with new icons, and a capacity section to give you more details on the current and maximum number of ingredients in a cup.
Resident Tea Making Stations
Bong-Cha has new tea table added. Remember that you can access Tea Time at Resident Tea Making Stations once you’ve reached a high enough friendship level with them!
Resident Tea Stations now have set configurations of teaware and ingredients for making tea at these tables. On the plus side, you won’t have to worry about depleting ingredients from your own stock!
Michi and Min’s Tea Tables have been adjusted to allow for more room for ingredients.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/0f6b49523b268b223dcd17e394ab2d994c6a0cad.png
Whim and Preferences
The Whim Order system has been adjusted to make sure that Residents aren’t accidentally requesting ingredients they don’t usually like.
Along with the new dialogue for resident tea requests and customer orders, the way whims are described in dialogue has been adjusted to help avoid confusion. For example, the “Herb” category of ingredients is now requested as “Something Herbaceous” to avoid confusing it with Herbal Tea!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/c577d4de9e0db763394301ac01d6da57c3b9a93b.png
Fixed bug where liquid ingredients would not properly appear if multiple types were selected (ie. Milk and Honey)
Glass bottle lid now closes properly
Water dispenser playing SFX while dispensing water
Notification bubbles no longer carrying over from previous day
Wallpaper customizations fixed, no longer applying material to entire wall (ie. door frames)
Removing duplicated recipes and no longer adding repices twice
Reaction particle effects fixed, now plays correct reaction after presenting tea to resident
Task List no longer showing on start menu
Fill Bar UI no longer showing for liquid containers that cannot be poured into (ie. creamers)
Decor item preview no longer lingering after exiting Decorating mode
Replaced missing material inside door of Player’s house
Various missing ingredient textures
Various NPC mini clipping errors
Various typos and dialogue errors

We hope that you enjoy all the new content in Pekoe, we love hearing from folks so feel free to give us a ping on socials or join us on Discord!

-Kitten Cup Studio

notes.title: Quality of Life Update [Version 0.2] is Now Live!
notes.content:
Hey, Tea Makers,

We have an exciting announcement for you today: we’re releasing our first major update for Pekoe! While we have been focused on diligently fixing bugs and issues in the initial weeks since release, we are also working on significant updates with new features and content. 

This update includes menu and UI improvements, many of which are based on your feedback, to make the gameplay experience smoother for everyone. We’re also thrilled to incorporate the first of many future dialogue additions, including new conversations with resident cats. This means more opportunities to get to know your neighbours and bump up those friendship points!

Another addition we’re excited about is a new Help Panel in the game’s journal menu. Right now, it includes a few Tips & Tricks to help clarify some confusion experienced by players, as well as a link to our new Gameplay Guide on Steam. Some of these gameplay snags will be addressed with future releases, but in the meantime, we’ll also be updating this Help Panel and Gameplay Guide throughout Early Access. Hopefully, this will assist players in bypassing some of the obstacles they are encountering and be a helpful resource to anyone who wants a more in-depth look into how the mechanics of the game work! 

Today’s update also includes some bug fixes, and we’ll continue to address any bugs with hotfixes and patches necessary. Your bug reports have been instrumental in helping us address these, and as a reminder, if you are experiencing a bug, you can report in-game by either pressing the F2 key or the drop-down button in the top right corner of the screen. We also have a bug channel in Discord for more in-depth or one-on-one support!

We’ll be releasing another QoL update at the end of July or early August, which will include features and changes that address smaller issues and areas for improvement. More details for today’s update are included below:

notes.title: Launch Week Round-up and Update v0.1.13!
notes.content:
It’s now been just over a week since Pekoe’s Early Access Launch! Seeing all of your reactions, feedback, and even bug reports has been so incredible. In large part thanks to all of your support, this is now our seventh patch update since we first launched!

With most of the major bugs and progress blockers (hopefully!) taken care of, we’ll be gradually switching over to larger, less frequent updates. These will include more gameplay changes and improvements, and incorporate some of the less urgent but no less valuable feedback we’ve received from players like you. We plan to release our first major patch, Version 0.2, by the end of the month, if not sooner. We’ll also be releasing a more detailed roadmap of future updates soon! 

This particular patch focuses on those progress-blocking and physics related bugs, as well as smoothing out the customer order experience, based on your feedback. We’ve also fixed a brand new Blooming Tea bug inadvertently caused by the previous patch.

For those of you who haven’t been following along with every patch, we’ve compiled some of the more significant bug fixes and improvements since our launch, and added them to the end of this update. Our launch discount will last until the end of the Steam Summer Sale on July 13th, so if you’ve been waiting for a smoother gameplay experience before taking a chance on our Early Access game, this may be the right time for you! We hope this past week demonstrates our dedication to Pekoe's continued development, and we’d love for you to join us in making Pekoe the best game it can possibly be.

Thanks again to everyone for working hard to help us address all of these issues as quickly as possible!

Version 0.1.13
[expand type=details]
Improvements

Customers will now appear while you are inside your house!
As a reminder, there is a chance of a new customer or resident request at the change of each hour. Previously, you would have to exit and re-enter your teahouse in order to see the newly arrived NPC, but now they will appear while you are already inside.
Additional prompts have been added, to remind players to try Solo Tea Making at least once to trigger a Solo Tea Making Tutorial
Not completing this tutorial may have been preventing customers from entering the shop
Bugs

Bug reports now working on Mac OS
Fixed blooming tea flower spawning bug
Fixed bug where teaware often wouldn’t instantiate properly while using Infuser Baskets

notes.title: Patch v0.1.12 is here!
notes.content:
Bugs & Balance Updates!

Hi everyone, we’ve got a second patch update for you this week! This one focuses on some lingering game-lock bugs we’ve noticed, as well as some pesky lingering issues we’ve noticed when restarting from the Main Menu. We've also addressed a bunch of issues with the Infuser Baskets.

In non-bug-related news, we’ve heard a lot of feedback about the shop mechanics. While we unfortunately can’t address everything right away, we definitely want to make sure that everyone has the basics they need, so we’ve updated some of the Resident Shop inventories. Staples like Milk, Cream and Sweetener are now available at all resident shops, and what’s more, we’re going to make sure that at least one of these staples will be available every day! Make sure to progress to the next day so that your shop inventories refresh with the new system!

We really appreciate everyone who is taking the time to help us improve our game! In that vein, we’ve added some contact info fields to our bug reporter. This is to help us get all of the information we need to improve your play experience, and maybe even get you some quicker updates about when those fixes and improvements are done. Of course, we do want to stress that providing your contact info is 100% optional!

The full list of changes and bug fixes is included below:
Improvements
Basic Milk and Sweetener ingredients made available in more shops
Shop inventory system adjusted to guarantee at least one milk or sugar in each shop every day
Updated Bug Reporter with option to provide contact info, for players who consent to being contacted with follow up questions, or notifications when the bug is fixed
Reduced amount of tea points award from Daily Cup Streak bonus, for balancing purposes

Bugs
Fixed Infuser Basket issues (getting stuck on cup, not resetting correctly)
Fixed bug where game locks when entering shops, after restarting from main menu
Fixed bug where button selection cursors wouldn’t show properly in Journal Menu (Resident Panel and Recipe Panels)
Fixed bug where drinking tea would not work with a glass bowl
Fixed “empty bubble” on Taffy’s dialogue, during conversation about sleeping
Butter now properly generates from containers

As a reminder, please make sure to restart Steam to receive the update. To learn more about known bugs and issues you can find them here.

notes.title: Build v0.1.10 is here!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, thanks for being patient with us.

As some of you may have seen, we released Patch 0.1.09 yesterday, found that it affected save data, and took it down within an hour. 

The good news is that the bug is fixed for this patch, and a new system is set up that should prevent this issue going forward. The bad news is that aspects of some saves will be affected, especially save files that have been used across multiple patches.

The biggest thing being affected is purchased items, especially the strawberry teaware set, any newer decor items, and ingredients. While we can get an approximate idea of which save files are missing items, we were not able to recover an exact record of what has been purchased.

To help make up for these lost items, all existing save files will be rewarded beans as compensation the first time they are loaded using the latest version of the game. Save files that are missing items will also receive an additional bonus per missing item. 

This version also includes improvements and bug fixes that were originally released as part of Version 0.1.09
Improvements
Updated Pambeh’s meows
Updated Credits
Increasing chances of having Friendship-Point Altering Dialogue with resident cats
Adjusted Bed & Breakfast shop hours to be open earlier
Updated Save system

Bugs
Fixed bug where tea or water would render entirely in black
Fixed bug where players were locked into Inventory menu, if checked during certain parts of the game intro
Fixed bug in final line of Mjorn’s dialogue when starting the Decor tutorial, which caused game to stall at a blank dialogue box
Fixed bug where Decor tutorial could be triggered a second time when reaching Town Level 3
Fixed issue with lower-case scripting commands which was preventing progression in Intro
Dried fruit, butter, and other ingredients that use the Rounded Cube ingredient shape no longer causing errors
Almond, Cocoa, Hazelnut powder, and Chaga should be working properly
Fixing incorrect prompt for Whisk in Teaware Selection when using Blooming Tea
Fixed bug where dialogue stalls during Min’s intro, due to ellipses in line “...Oh…”
Glass bottles should now properly render liquid meshes (though some of them still need a material update)


Thank you all for your patience and understanding as we work through all of these bugs, and a special thank you to everyone who has submitted bug reports, they’ve been incredibly helpful!

As a reminder, please make sure to restart Steam to receive the update. To learn more about known bugs and issues you can find them here.

notes.title: Demo Updates!!
notes.content:
Hey folks,

First of all, thank you so much to everyone who's played the demo! It's been really cool checking out all the data and streams of folks playing, so a huge meow of thanks from the dev team.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715618/22cfc883128583196253c450c1c4742d18b0f6d8.gif

We've been making small fixes and updates over the course of the week using the feedback and bug reports that we've been receiving. If you haven't closed Steam since downloading, we would suggest you do just to make sure you have the most up to date version. First let's go over what's been fixed!


 Navigation arrows not working

 Arrows now work when clicked on and when arrow keys are used

 Blooming tea tin not spawning correctly

 Blooming tea will now appear correctly during Min's tea making

 Game not progressing at certain points in dialogue with ellipses in text

 Turns out there's a different between "…" and "...", thanks Google correct and unicode!


There are a few however that we need more time to replicate to fix so we wanted to go over bugs we know are coming up and how best to deal with them.


 Teaware cannot be interacted with during Taffy's tutorial

 Unfortunately you need to restart the demo.

 Unable to re-enter player's house after meeting Tea Sprite for the first time

 Unfortunately you need to restart the demo. You can chose to skip Taffy's tutorial by selecting "Settle In".

 Unable to complete second day/go to sleep at the end of the second day

 The end of the second day is the end of the demo, so if you're unable to proceed there isn't more than a bit more dialogue from the Tea Sprite


Found a bug? Let us know either by accessing the feedback form in game, or by  accessing it here! Any feedback and reports are appreciated as they help us understand who's getting different bugs. 

And with that we have a special announcement.... WE'RE KEEPING THE DEMO UP UNTIL FEBRUARY 22ND!!! That's right, while we had originally only planned to keep it up for Steam Next Fest, we're going to be a part of the Indie Cup happening February 14th through 22nd. 

Thanks for all the support folks, we hope you've enjoyed your time in Pekoe so far!

-Kitten Cup Studio
